Oh man, leaving them on ice like that is harder for me than I thought…
That’s how life is! One must think about his own good first! 
A-and it’s not like I can’t go to Church ever again, right? 
Maybe Shanice will find a different bot, or maybe even another method to help him!
There are so many things that could go wrong with me showing her my sexbot. 
It’s just too much risk…
She could rat me out, laugh at me or even blackmail!
It is how it is, I just can’t trust her with my most important secret.
